id: \bThank you so much for chasing them away. The thought of them stealing the ribbon terrifies me.
en: \bThank you so much for chasing them away. The thought of them stealing the ribbon terrifies me.
it: \bGrazie mille per averli scacciati. Il solo pensiero che rubassero il fiocco mi terrorizza.

id: \bYou want to go to Lavaridge Town? I'll tell the guard to let you through.
en: \bYou want to go to Lavaridge Town? I'll tell the guard to let you through.
it: \bVuoi andare a Cuordilava? Dirò alla guardia di lasciarti passare.

id: \bThank you for chasing away those people.
en: \bThank you for chasing away those people.

id: \bAfter spending years in this town I decided to help out and teach the move, Pain Split.
en: \bAfter spending years in this town I decided to help out and teach the move, Pain Split.
it: \bDopo aver passato anni in questa città, ho deciso di rendermi utile insegnando la mossa Malcomune.

id: \bI can teach it to you if you want?
en: \bI can teach it to you if you want?

id: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
en: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
it: \bA quale Pokémon vuoi che la insegni?

id: \rI'm very sorry, but you missed the deadline to compete.
en: \rI'm very sorry, but you missed the deadline to compete.
it: \rMi dispiace molto, ma il termine per le iscrizioni è scaduto.

id: \rJessie: What do you mean I lost the contest?!?! Didn't you see how marvelous my Pokémon were?
en: \rJessie: What do you mean I lost the contest?!?!  Didn't you see how marvelous my Pokémon were?
it: \rJessie: Come sarebbe a dire che ho perso la Gara?!?! Non avete visto quanto erano meravigliosi i miei Pokémon?

id: \bMeowth: I say we just steal the ribbon.
en: \bMeowth: I say we just steal the ribbon.
it: \bMeowth: Io dico di rubare il fiocco e basta.

id: \bJames: The twerp!? At a time like this?
en: \bJames: The twerp!? At a time like this?

id: \rJessie: I guess we get a ribbon and some Pokémon.
en: \rJessie: I guess we get a ribbon and some Pokémon.
it: \rJessie: A quanto pare ci prendiamo un fiocco e un po' di Pokémon.

id: \bThe contest was amazing! If only they had these in my hometown.
en: \bThe contest was amazing! If only they had these in my hometown.
it: \bLa gara è stata fantastica! Peccato che non ne facciano nella mia città.

id: \rI was runner up. I need to train harder.
en: \rI was runner up. I need to train harder.
it: \rSono arrivata seconda. Devo allenarmi di più.
